DeepCool AG300 Single Tower CPU Cooler – High-Performance Cooling for Mainstream CPUs

Experience reliable and efficient cooling with the DeepCool AG300 Single Tower CPU Cooler, expertly designed to deliver optimal thermal performance for Intel and AMD processors. Featuring a compact single-tower heatsink design, the AG300 is equipped with a high-efficiency 120mm PWM fan and three direct-touch copper heat pipes for fast and effective heat dissipation.

Built with performance and quiet operation in mind, the AG300 maintains low temperatures and minimal noise levels, even during heavy gaming or multitasking. Its slim profile ensures excellent RAM compatibility and easy installation in most mid-tower and micro-ATX cases. The universal mounting kit supports a wide range of CPU sockets, including Intel LGA1700/1200/115x and AMD AM5/AM4, making it a versatile cooling solution for new builds or upgrades.

Key Features:

  • Advanced single-tower air cooling with high-density aluminum fins
  • 120mm PWM fan for smart, quiet, and efficient airflow control
  • 3 direct-contact copper heat pipes for fast heat transfer
  • Compact design for wide case and RAM clearance compatibility
  • Easy installation with multi-platform mounting support (Intel & AMD)
